question: ‘Moon Walk’ is an autobiography of _______.
solution:
The correct option is __**Michael Jackson.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ‘Moon Walk’ is an autobiography of **Michael Joseph Jackson.**
 
• **He** was born on August 29, 1958 died on June 25, 2009.
 
• Jackson was an **American singer, songwriter, dancer, and philanthropist.**
 
• He is known as "**The King of Pop**" and regarded as one of the most significant cultural figures of the 20th century.
 
• Some honors given to Jackson includes:
 
 
• "Presidential Public Safety Commendation" award by Ronald Reagan in 1984.
 
• "Artist of the Decade" by George H. W. Bush in 1990.
 
• "Point of Light Ambassador" by Bush in 1992.
 
• The RIAA regards him as the biggest-selling music artist of all time worldwide.
 
 
 
• Jackson has** ****13 Grammy Awards, Grammy Legend Award, Grammy Legend Award** and many more awards.
 
• In 2021, he was among the inaugural inductees into the** Black Music & Entertainment Walk of Fame.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Oscar Wilde**

 
 
• Oscar Fingal O'Flahertie Wills Wilde was an Irish poet and playwright.
 
• Oscar Wilde: His Life and Confessions (1916) was one his biographies written by Frank Harris.
 
 
 
• **Marlon Brando**
 
 
• He as an American actor born on April 3, 1924 and died on July 1, 2004.
 
• He won many awards including two Golden Globe Awards and two Academy Awards and three British Academy Film Awards.
 
• "The Godfather" is one of his remarkable work in film industry.
 
 
 
• **Anne Frank**
 
 
• Annelies Marie "Anne" Frank, was a German-Dutch diarist of Jewish heritage.
 
• "The Story of a Young Girl" was her diary which gained popularity after her death.
